description: This file is a Python script implementing a Streamlit web app for chatting with documents using LlamaIndex and various language models (Gemini, OpenAI, custom). It includes functions for setting up service contexts, processing documents, and managing the chat interface.

methods.name: gemini_service_context
methods.description: Sets up a Gemini-based service context with GooglePaLMEmbedding and applies it globally.

methods.name: openai_service_context
methods.description: Sets up an OpenAI-based service context with OpenAIEmbedding and applies it globally.

methods.name: custom_model
methods.description: Sets up a custom service context combining OpenAI and GooglePaLMEmbedding.

methods.name: process_documents_for_gemini
methods.description: Processes documents in a directory to create or load a Gemini index for querying.

methods.name: process_documents_for_openai
methods.description: Processes documents to create or load an OpenAI index for querying.

methods.name: process_documents_for_custom
methods.description: Processes documents to create or load a custom index.

methods.name: app
methods.description: Main Streamlit app function managing UI, file uploads, index creation, and chat interactions.
